1: // Neon Light Runner – minimal implementation
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
10: 
11:   // Game state
12:   let score = 0;
13:   let energy = 1; // 0‑1 range
14:   let lastTime = 0;
15:   const ship = {x: 80, y: H/2, w: 30, h: 20, vy: 0, gravity: 0.4, jump: -8};
16:   const obstacles = [];
17:   const orbs = [];
18: 
19:   // Input – tap / click to ascend
20:   const onPress = () => { ship.vy = ship.jump; };
21:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onPress);
22:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onPress);
23: 
24:   // Helper functions
25:   const rectCollide = (a,b) => a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
26:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
27:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
28:     obstacles.push({x: W, y: H - size, w: size, h: size, speed: 4 + Math.random()*2});
29:   };
30:   const spawnOrb = () => {
31:     const r = 8;
32:     const y = Math.random() * (H - 2*r) + r;
33:     orbs.push({x: W, y, r, speed: 3});
34:   };
35: 
36:   // Main loop
37:   function update(dt) {
38:     // Ship physics
39:     ship.vy += ship.gravity;
40:     ship.y += ship.vy;
41:     if (ship.y + ship.h > H) { ship.y = H - ship.h; ship.vy = 0; }
42:     if (ship.y < 0) { ship.y = 0; ship.vy = 0; }
43: 
44:     // Move obstacles & orbs
45:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= o.speed);
46:     orbs.forEach(o => o.x -= o.speed);
47:     // Remove off‑screen
48:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
49:     while (orbs.length && orbs[0].x + orbs[0].r < 0) orbs.shift();
50: 
51:     // Spawn logic
52:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnObstacle();
53:     if (Math.random() < 0.015) spawnOrb();
54: 
55:     // Collision detection
56:     for (const o of obstacles) {
57:       if (rectCollide(ship, o)) { energy = 0; }
58:     }
59:     for (let i=orbs.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
60:       const orb = orbs[i];
61:       const dx = (ship.x + ship.w/2) - orb.x;
62:       const dy = (ship.y + ship.h/2) - orb.y;
63:       if (dx*dx + dy*dy < (orb.r+10)*(orb.r+10)) { // collect
64:         orbs.splice(i,1);
65:         energy = Math.min(1, energy + 0.1);
66:         score += 10;
67:       }
68:     }
69:     // Energy drain
70:     energy -= dt * 0.0002;
71:     if (energy <= 0) { // Game over – reset
72:       alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
73:       score = 0; energy = 1; ship.y = H/2; ship.vy = 0; obstacles.length = 0; orbs.length = 0;
74:     }
75:     score += dt * 0.01;
76:   }
77:

79:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
80:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
81:     // neon ship
82:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
83:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
84:     // obstacles
85:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
86:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
87:     // orbs

90:     // UI – score & energy bar
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
92:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
93:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
95:     ctx.fillRect(10, 30, energy*100, 10);
96:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
97:     ctx.strokeRect(10,30,100,10);
98:   }
99: 
100:   function loop(timestamp) {
101:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
102:     lastTime = timestamp;
103:     update(dt);
104:     draw();
105:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
106:   }
